author: Nelev
body:
## What
When the model call fails (OpenRouter down, timeout, rate limit), \`/ask\` and \`/documents\` now return \`503\` instead of a bare \`500\`, and a short apology is stored as the assistant's turn.

## Why
The user's turn is committed before the model runs, so a provider error left an unanswered question in the thread and a generic 500.

## How
- \`langchain_agent/agent.py\`: \`answer\` turns \`OpenAIError\` into \`AgentUnavailable\`.
- \`controller/conversation.py\`: \`answer_and_store\` catches it, stores and commits the apology, re-raises.
- \`main.py\`: one handler logs the cause and returns 503.
- README documents the new response.

Only \`OpenAIError\` is translated; other failures still surface as 500.

## Test plan
- [x] \`uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run pytest -q\` (177 passed)
